notes.title: Permanently retiring the game
notes.notes:
Although the game was published to Early Access in a playable state I was unable to finalize its idealized completion. I can no longer work on it, and since I don't believe it to meet the standards necessary for full release the game will be delisted and permanently retired from sale on Steam.
Those who own the game will continue to do so, and the game will remain in your steam library.
My apologies.

notes.title: Support suspended indefinitely
notes.notes:
As you might notice, there has been a lack of updates. I'm the only LILT dev and unfortunately I will most likely no longer be working or updating the game due to work and being involved in other projects that are more attractive to me.

I apologize for those who have bought the game and expected more. Those who can and wish to do so may refund it through Steam Refunds.

I am unsure at this point if LILT will be removed from Steam or released as is.

Thank you.
